root_cause_hypothesis: validate_code(mode="references") reported 2 not-visible-from-model errors for ProcessGuidePage/ProcessGuideDataTypeNames AFTER the ProcessGuide package had been added to fm-mcp Descriptor ModuleReferences on disk. buildModelVisibility() run fresh over the same descriptor returns hasProcessGuide=true, and xppc compiled the class with 0 errors/0 warnings, so the gate verdict and the build disagree (false positive). Cause: src/metadata/modelDescriptor.ts holds the Descriptor answer in a process-lifetime Map (visibilityCache, line 93) that is never invalidated - no code path anywhere in src/ clears it, and update_symbol_index (which does refresh the bridge provider and invalidate the workspace scan cache) does not touch it. Any out-of-band Descriptor edit is therefore invisible for the rest of the server session.
suggested_fix_area: src/metadata/modelDescriptor.ts (visibilityCache: mtime-stamp the Descriptor XML or expose clearModelVisibilityCache()), wired into the update_symbol_index cache-refresh path in src/tools/write/updateSymbolIndex (bridge/cache refresh) so a Descriptor edit is picked up without a server restart.
